title: Successful Admin User Authentication
preconditions: User must have valid administrator credentials.

testSteps.expectedResult: User is authenticated and redirected to the Dashboard page.

expectedResults: System displays an error alert 'Invalid credentials'.

testSteps.action: User submits the login form with empty username or password fields.
